Elena Vasquez, MSN, RN, CEN
Emergency Department Nurse Manager | Level II trauma center | Staffing and throughput
Phoenix, Arizona, United States

Summary
I run a 42-bed emergency department at a Level II trauma center, with 96 nurses and techs across three shifts. Over the last two years my team cut the share of patients who left without being seen from 5.1% to 2.3% by adding a triage nurse at the front door and changing how we open overflow beds.

Before management I was a bedside ED nurse for nine years, six of them as charge nurse on nights. I still pick up a shift a month.

I'm not looking, but I'm glad to talk with other ED leaders about staffing models and split-flow.

Experience

Saguaro Valley Medical Center
Nurse Manager, Emergency Department
April 2021 - Present (4 years 8 months)
Phoenix, Arizona, United States
Lead a 42-bed ED with 96 nurses and techs and 71,000 visits a year.
Cut left-without-being-seen from 5.1% to 2.3% in two years with front-door triage and a new overflow plan.
Brought RN turnover down from 24% to 13% by moving to self-scheduling and a paid preceptor track.
Own a $14.5M labor budget; finished the last two fiscal years within 1% of plan.
